design.registration: Before public-only play, after frozen core and mechanical screen; safe isolation already known as an important counterexample.
design.experienceEngine: Traffic leaves directional history that catalyzes future operators; persistent rhythms can themselves become combination operands, and connecting them changes their behavior.
design.valuedObject: A moving creation and the shared places through which it can join another
design.renewalPromise: A retained form or a coupling consequence may give the player a concrete next construction they want to attempt.

combining.skill: Reason about paths, timing, recovery and an existing place’s past

combining.meaning: Place supplies memory; time supplies phase; a created process becomes an ingredient

intentionsBeforeActions.intention: Build an independent clockwise six-place loop in C1,D1,D2,D3,C3,C2, preserving the west loop.
intentionsBeforeActions.expected: C1 becomes the northwest corner; west pulse keeps circulating.

reportedExperience.value: Clear and predictable construction: six conductors, launch, one-lap confirmation. I solved the requested ring topology immediately; most placement was routine.

account.experience: I built the obvious six-place clockwise ring on the east, injected a positive pulse, and waited one lap. I could predict routing from the public rules; the only material uncertainty was whether recognition required the initially blank scars to settle.
account.noticedResponses: West remained period four throughout. East gained directional scars on successful arrivals and was recognized as period six after a full lap. The new whole form became an inexhaustible capability.
account.closure: The two independent rhythms meet the aim. I prefer preserving this completed arrangement to editing merely because extra recipes exist.
account.repetition: After choosing the ring topology, the six conductor placements were routine execution, with no competing plan or consequential tradeoff. Launch and recurrence confirmation were the strongest payoff.
account.narrativeOrConceptThatMattered: Creating a separate living rhythm beside an existing rhythm gave the construction a coherent purpose. No hidden story was needed. Place history changed future recipe eligibility, and the completed form unlocked a reusable whole, but neither changed what I needed for this aim.
account.concreteNextWish: A reason for two rhythms to coexist or interact that makes preserving, coupling, or changing them matter to an independently evolving situation. I do not currently have a particular experiment I want enough to disturb this ending.
account.measurement: This is an AI protocol choice, not a claim about human enjoyment or elapsed human play time.

experienceAcrossTime.narrativeOrConceptualReport: Making a second living rhythm beside the first mattered; extra feature availability did not create a particular next goal.

noticedResponses.value: Successful arrivals established directional history. Both loops sustained independently. Full-form recognition unlocked form-e9059314; I did not reuse it or a history-dependent recipe.

unclassifiedPlayerFields.value: I predicted blank scars would delay exact recognition, launched clockwise from C1, then saw the full lap establish scars and unlock the six-place form while the west loop kept running.

structuralReuse.interpretation: A structural use may be a normal prerequisite. Meaningful development requires its role and player experience, not this count alone.
